skills.summary: Plan keyword research for a site or topic
skills.job: Build a keyword research plan with seed topics, intent groups and checks against live results.

skills.summary: Audit one page for on-page SEO
skills.job: Check a single page for title, headings, content match, links and markup, and list fixes by priority.
triggers: why is my page not ranking

skills.summary: Write title tags and meta descriptions
skills.job: Write title tags and meta descriptions that fit length limits and match the page and its intent.

skills.summary: Outline a blog post around search intent
skills.job: Plan a blog post structure from the reader's question, with headings, points, sources and a call to action.
triggers: structure an article on this topic

skills.summary: Plan a content calendar for a period
skills.job: Lay out a realistic publishing schedule with topics, formats, owners and review points.

skills.summary: Write landing page copy from a brief
skills.job: Write the sections of a landing page for one audience and one action, using supplied proof only.

skills.summary: Write ad copy variants within platform limits
skills.job: Write several distinct ad variants for a platform, checking its current limits and policies.
gotchas: variants that differ only in wording

skills.summary: Define a brand voice guide with examples
skills.job: Describe a brand voice with traits, do and do-not rules and before and after examples drawn from real samples.

skills.summary: Write a marketing campaign brief
skills.job: Write a brief with goal, audience, message, channels, budget, timeline and measures for one campaign.

skills.summary: Plan a marketing A/B test
skills.job: Design a test with one change, a hypothesis, a metric, a sample plan and a stop rule decided in advance.

skills.summary: Research a content or ad audience
skills.job: Find where an audience gathers, what they ask and how they talk, from live sources, with citations.

skills.summary: Write a LinkedIn post from a point of view
skills.job: Write a LinkedIn post with a clear first line, one idea and an honest tone, from the user's own material.

skills.summary: Script a short video with hook and shots
skills.job: Write a script for a video under about a minute with hook, body, cut points and a single action.
triggers: write a video for my product

skills.summary: Plan and write link outreach emails
skills.job: Find link targets with a real reason to link and write short, honest outreach messages.
triggers: ask sites to link to my guide

skills.summary: Repurpose one piece into several formats
skills.job: Turn one source piece into a set of posts, emails and clips that each stand alone.

skills.summary: Build FAQ content with valid schema markup
skills.job: Write FAQ questions and answers and valid JSON-LD markup, checking current search guidelines.

skills.summary: Find topics rivals cover that you do not
skills.job: Compare the content of rivals with the user's site and list gaps and chances ranked by fit.

skills.summary: Plan a marketing email sequence
skills.job: Design a short email sequence with a goal per message, timing, exit rules and honest subject lines.

skills.summary: Plan UTM naming and campaign tracking
skills.job: Define a UTM naming scheme and a tracking sheet so campaign data can be compared later.

skills.summary: Map keywords to search intent and page type
skills.job: Group keywords by what searchers want and match each group to a page type by checking live results.
triggers: which page should target this keyword

skills.summary: Plan internal links across a site
skills.job: Map hub and supporting pages and write link suggestions with natural anchor text.

skills.summary: Decide which old posts to update or drop
skills.job: Review existing content and sort each piece into keep, update, merge or remove with reasons.

skills.summary: Write an SEO brief for a writer
skills.job: Write a brief with target query, intent, angle, outline, sources and internal links for one article.
